blog_posts.title: Hello World!
blog_posts.content: It seems like I finally have the web page I wanted. I think at some point I'll figure out a way to add images to my project posts, but for now, I am just really happy that I got this thing running the way I wanted. My head is hurting, but I have my lunch meal prep done for the rest of the week, and I am ready to just lie down. I think I will be stuck awake for a little bit longer, though.

logs.title: Opening My First Project
logs.content: I'm hoping to get started on this project Friday after I get off work. Throughout the week, I might do some conceptual breakdowns and map out the different scripts I need—like an update script and eventually the respawn script—to figure out how they will look. I might also do some brainstorming on other ideas, such as deciding whether to make it a modded server. I'm a bit concerned about the system requirements, though, since I won't be running it on a very powerful computer.

logs.title: Where It Stands
logs.content: I've been working on this DS for a little bit now. I replaced the shell and the touch screen a while back, but then my shoulder button failed as I was playing with it. The shoulder button had failed back when I was a kid, then miraculously started working again when I was an adult—but of course, it went back to failing the second I finished replacing its shell. So, I took it upon myself to desolder the old shoulder buttons and attempt to solder on a new pair. God forbid I replaced just the one, only for the other to fail right after.</br> I nearly caught the PCB on fire trying to use a heat gun to resolder them with some lead-free solder. Despite charring the board, I managed (several days later) to solder on one of the two switches. I haven't checked for continuity yet, so it could still be fucked anyhow. I have yet to solder the electrical connections on the other switch, but it's physically secured by its structural anchoring pins—I bet there's a technical word for that. Hopefully, I can knock out this last switch and check for continuity this weekend.
